subject: Ariba onboarding — legal term cascade and PO acknowledgement mapping
messages:
From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>
To: Prashant Reddy <prashant.reddy@pinebridgehealth.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>, Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 24 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Ariba onboarding — legal term cascade and PO acknowledgement mapping

Hi Prashant / Susan —

Quick check-in from the onboarding side as you attempt to complete Ariba registration. Two items popped up during our validation: the MSA redline we received includes a payment/invoice acknowledgement clause (Section 7.2) that requires invoice acknowledgement within 3 business days, but Ariba POs in your environment currently show an acceptance window of 7 calendar days before we treat them as "auto-accepted." That mismatch causes a routing problem: invoices created from an Ariba PO might be marked as non-acknowledged by our billing flow even though Ariba shows the PO as "Accepted."

Can you confirm whether you can change the Ariba PO acceptance window or if you'd prefer Redwood to treat Ariba "Accept" as satisfying the invoice acknowledgement for Order Form-derived invoices? We'll need to pick one approach and reflect it in the Order Form and onboarding playbook.

I've attached the MSA redline (MSA_redline_PineBridge_v2.pdf) and the draft Order Form that maps Ariba fields to our invoice/ack statuses (OrderForm_PineBridge.xlsx).

Next steps I propose:
- You confirm Ariba acceptance window / ability to change PO acceptance to 3 business days (or confirm you want to keep 7 days).
- We pick a mapping: either adjust your Ariba window or Redwood adds the mapping exception in the Order Form.
- Legal to sign off on whichever approach and we update DocuSign/Order Form.

If helpful, we can set a quick 30-min call tomorrow to finalize.

Thanks,
Camila Reyes
Partner Onboarding | Redwood Inference
camila.reyes@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123

Attachments: MSA_redline_PineBridge_v2.pdf (draft redline, key notes highlighted); OrderForm_PineBridge.xlsx (field mapping stub)

From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>, Prashant Reddy <prashant.reddy@pinebridgehealth.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 25 Jun 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Ariba onboarding — legal term cascade and PO acknowledgement mapping

Thanks for flagging, Camila. A few technical notes from the integration/EDI side that should help the legal redline and Order Form wording: 

1) Ariba PO lifecycle: the PO goes through statuses (Pending -> Sent -> Acknowledged/Accepted). Our ingestion pipeline treats the Ariba "Accepted" flag as evidence the vendor has acknowledged the PO. If PineBridge's Ariba instance allows a 7-day auto-accept policy, that will still surface as "Accepted."

2) We can implement a mapping exception on Redwood's side fairly quickly: when source = "Ariba" && PO.status = "Accepted" then map to InvoiceAck = true. That avoids needing PineBridge to change their Ariba window. However, that must be contractually captured in the Order Form (i.e., define "Ariba Accept" as valid acknowledgement for invoicing).

3) If legal wants the 3 business day acknowledgement requirement preserved, they'd need to accept a carve-out for Ariba-originated POs or we need PineBridge to shorten their window. Operationally, we prefer a contract carve-out for Ariba since it keeps onboarding friction low.

Suggested redline snippet for the Order Form (for legal to insert):
"For purchase orders issued via PineBridge's Ariba Network, a PO status of 'Accepted' within Ariba shall be deemed an acknowledgement sufficient for Redwood to issue invoices under this Order Form."

I also linked the HubSpot deal so legal/ops can quickly reference the SOW and payment terms: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/HB-12987

Happy to hop on a call with PineBridge if you want an operational walk-through.

- Priyom
Principal Onboarding Engineer | Redwood Inference

From: Prashant Reddy <prashant.reddy@pinebridgehealth.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>
Cc: Susan Tan <susan.tan@pinebridgehealth.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 26 Jun 2026 08:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Ariba onboarding — legal term cascade and PO acknowledgement mapping

Hi Camila / team —

Thanks for the clear summary. Quick answers from our side: 
- We can keep the Ariba acceptance window at 7 days (that's baked into a few downstream workflows here). Changing it would require a change request with our procurement team and will take time.
- We are fine with Redwood treating Ariba "Accepted" as sufficient acknowledgement for invoicing, provided that is clearly written into the Order Form.

Two additional onboarding items to call out so they can be included in the Order Form mapping:
1) Tax ID: our legal ops needs the Redwood remit-to tax id field to be present on invoices generated from Ariba to ensure automated tax validation. Can you confirm the exact field name Redwood writes to?
2) ASN/EDI: Our warehouse team wants to confirm whether Redwood will emit an ASN when we send goods; currently PineBridge expects an ASN after invoice. If that's not part of your standard flow we can mark it as N/A in the Order Form.

I've attached a small sample PO export (po_sample.xml) to illustrate the structure we send.

If Laura needs us to agree to the redline language, we can do a quick one-line amendment in the Order Form and sign.

Regards,
Prashant Reddy
Head of Vendor Ops | PineBridge Health
prashant.reddy@pinebridgehealth.com
Attachments: po_sample.xml (PO export sample)

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Prashant Reddy <prashant.reddy@pinebridgehealth.com>, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 26 Jun 2026 17:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Ariba onboarding — legal term cascade and PO acknowledgement mapping

Prashant — thanks, that helps.

We will accept the carve-out that treats Ariba's 'Accepted' status as sufficient acknowledgement for invoicing, but we will memorialize the mapping in the Order Form and add a short mapping table. Please review the proposed language below and confirm: 

Proposed Order Form amendment (to be appended as an addendum):
"For Purchase Orders issued via the Ariba Network to Redwood Inference, a PO status of 'Accepted' in Ariba shall be deemed a valid acknowledgement for purposes of invoice issuance and payment under the Order Form. Redwood will expose the following fields on invoices produced from Ariba-sourced POs: 'RemitTaxID', 'PO_Number', 'Line_Item_ID', 'Currency', and 'Invoice_Date'."

Operational notes/requests: 
- Prashant: confirm 'RemitTaxID' in your sample PO (po_sample.xml) maps to your tax validation process — if it uses a different element name, please indicate the exact XPath or element name.
- Priyom: please add the single-sentence carve-out into the OrderForm_PineBridge.xlsx and capture the Po.status->InvoiceAck mapping as "Ariba.Accepted -> InvoiceAck = true".
- Camila: once Priyom updates the Order Form, I'll sign off on the legal side and we can issue the DocuSign for the Order Form addendum.

If everything is aligned, we can finalize the addendum and do a fast-track signature. I'm happy to execute the DocuSign once the mapping sheet is attached.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel | Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.ai
